name: Antonio Acevedo
source:
"Mr. Moss, will you please get that out of your mouth."

A compassionate and intelligent man with absolutely zero flaws, Dr. Acevedo has recently taken the troublesome Manson under his care. He takes great pride in his job, but when not working, he'll always be found resting in his armchair listening to opera.
